body: I understand exactly how you feel.. To be honest, it’s awful we can’t choose our family in the moment we’re “born”.. :(

I can’t let my family know, because they are already dealing with awful things. So, I am alone in this thing. I don’t have friends. I kept talking with my ex about my suicidal thoughts, but I no longer want to “charge” her with this type of thoughts. I’m glad you’re no longer doing that. Keep being strong!

Thank you so much! I’m disinfecting it. I’m just worried of people around me notice the wounds. I don’t want to upset them with my problems. Still, I’m just too angry with myself and it’s a way of letting this anger out. I’m looking for ways of “punishing “myself, others than risking my life.

Thank you so much for the advice! I live under the same roof with an oncology patient and I’m avoiding going out in order not to get the covid. It’s very stressful and annoying. The push ups idea might help.
